programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: It's story time with JJ's favorite songs and stories! First, sing along to 'Wheels on the Bus' as JJ and his friends put on an interactive show. Then, settle in for some classic tales. Watch as the three little pigs try to build houses strong enough to keep the Big Bad Wolf away. Then, find out who wins a big race: the speedy hare or the slow and steady tortoise! Finally, learn a lesson about working hard with the story of the Grasshopper and the Ants.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Go on a big animal adventure with JJ! The fun starts on Grandpa's farm, where JJ learns all about the animals and the sounds they make. He even helps give a sheep a bath! Then, it's time to head to the ocean. Join JJ and his family as they visit an aquarium and sing 'Baby Shark' with a real shark family! The adventure gets prehistoric when Ms. Appleberry teaches the class all about their favorite dinosaurs. From guessing games to meeting Bingo the dog, it's a wild day!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John for a fun day at school! First, he learns that karate can be challenging, but with a lot of practice, he learns how to kick, punch and move! Then, he learns how to play soccer with the help of his big brother and sister. The day continues with a special surprise guest who drops in and teaches the gang how to play different instruments, like the piano, trumpet and guitar! It's always a fun day of learning at school!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John for some imagination and problem-solving fun! Oh no, Teddy is missing! But don't worry, Mom, Dad, Jack and Jill are all there to help Baby John search for him and solve the mystery. Then, dressed as pigs, Baby John, Jack and Jill use their imagination to re-enact the classic 'Three Little Pigs' story, with Dad playing the Big Bad Wolf! The problem-solving continues as the family helps guide Jill through the experience of losing her first tooth.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: The Insectibles' day turns from sweet to peril when Willow is lured into a glass trap by pink lemonade, and the entire team gets stuck trying to rescue her. With the glass heating up, Syd races to save them. No sooner are they free than a mysterious, destructive light ray begins burning through the backyard. The team realizes it's a Shrinkinator lens, and they must now race against Adilla and her roaches to retrieve it before it causes more chaos.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: The day takes a disastrous turn when Gramps, and then Zak, are swallowed whole by a giant koi fish! As the rest of the team tries to figure out how to rescue them, their problems get even bigger. They are ambushed by Adilla's roaches, who capture them to be the 'special gift' for Lidia's birthday party. The remaining Insectibles must now escape a bizarre party to save their friends from the belly of a fish.

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: When Adilla fires the roach brothers, Hye and Lo, the Insectibles make a surprising decision and recruit them for a mission to retrieve a Shrinkinator part. This strange new alliance is immediately tested when their quest leads them into a mysterious house. Trapped inside with a community of bonkers bugs and their formidable caretaker, Nurse Bapkis, the team must devise a clever plan to escape.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi as he explores the amazing animals of the ocean! First, he journeys over the waves in a boat, searching for majestic dolphins! He learns why it's important to protect our waters for the amazing animals living in them. Then, Blippi visits the Marine Life Centre to learn all about incredible underwater animals like octopus, sharks, crabs and more! It's an ocean adventure full of discovering amazing animals!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi is exploring some mighty machines at work! First, he visits a construction yard to learn all about skid steers. He explores all the parts of the skid steer, inside and out, while learning how they work and how they're used. Then, Blippi takes you for a ride inside a real forklift! He learns about these amazing construction trucks as he explores all their different parts before trying his hand at lifting something with the forklift himself!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Is Meekah up for the ultimate dance challenge? When her Dino Buddy wants to be a musician, Meekah takes her to a music studio to create a song and learn about counting beats. Then, she learns the foundations of gymnastics, like how to do a forward roll and walk on the balance beam. Finally, she visits an awesome indoor playground, where she plays a fun game where she has to dance her way to each of the different play areas!

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah for a fun day at Jumper Jungle indoor playground! On a day of sporty play, Meekah finds different sports balls, including a basketball and a soccer ball. As she collects them, she searches for the best place to play each sports game. Then, it's a day of bouncy play! Join Meekah as she bounces around the inflatable play structures and bounces like a bunny, frolics like a frog and hops like a hare!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are facing some challenging situations! When Fuse gets a birthday present of a skydiving ticket, he's too proud to tell Bubbles he's scared of heights and tries to face his fears. Then, Zee is cupcake crazy! When he discovers Bubbles is running a cupcake factory out of her house, he finds it impossible to control himself. The challenges continue when Newt crashes one of Fuse's fishing expeditions and turns out to be a natural!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are on the move! When modifications to Fuse's truck cause it to develop a mind of its own and turn truly monstrous, he must take back control to protect his friends. Then, Pogo loses his license after a bout of reckless driving and is horrified to discover that he's got Jeff as his examiner! Plus, when Newt is upstaged by Pogo, she grows determined to become strong herself with some help from Fuse.

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: It's a fun day at the petting zoo with Blippi! He visits The Pet Zoo in Brazil and learns how to be an animal caretaker! He gets to visit and feed some amazing animals like ducks, pigs, an ostrich and an alpaca! Blippi ends his exciting day by meeting adorable puppies!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Blippi visits The Pet Zoo in Brazil and learns how to be an animal caretaker! He visits and feeds some ducks, pigs, an ostrich and an alpaca. He also takes a slide break and carriage ride during his visit and ends the day playing with puppies!

Then, settle in for some classic tales. Watch as the three little pigs try to build houses strong enough to keep the Big Bad Wolf away. Then, find out who wins a big race: the speedy hare or the slow and steady tortoise! Finally, learn a lesson about working hard with the story of the Grasshopper and the Ants.

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ for a nature walk and some of his favorite rhymes! First, JJ's family shows him all the fun things we can do to help the Earth, like sorting trash for recycling. Then, the kids go on a nature walk with Bingo, collecting fun information in their scrapbooks! After the outdoor fun, it's time for classic rhymes. Sing along as ten animal friends try to share a bed and help the three little kittens who have lost their mittens!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Being little can be tough, but Baby John is growing up! First, he thinks he's ready to be big and make all his own decisions, but Mom and Dad help him understand that being little is pretty awesome, too! Then, Mom helps Baby John learn how to express all his different emotions and feelings, from grumpy to happy to proud. When Baby John loses his pacifier, the whole family joins in to help him on the big search!

programme.title: Little Angel
programme.desc: Join Baby John as he learns all about being safe! First, he learns how important it is to always put on his seatbelt when he goes for a ride. Then, Mom and Dad teach the kids what to do if an accident happens and how to avoid them. The safety lessons continue as Baby John learns how to be safe while playing at the playground, at the beach and even while swimming in the pool. It's always important to be safe!

programme.title: Mia's Magic Playground
programme.desc: Welcome to Mia's Magic Playground! Join Mia and best friends Oskar and Tilly on their wild adventures, as they explore a whimsical land together, full of walking rainbows, ice cream bears and singing trees. No matter what is happening in the real world, adventure always awaits them in their imagination.

programme.title: Mia's Magic Playground

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah for a fun day of caring for cute pets! First, she pretends to be a veterinarian at the Twinkle Play Space! She goes through Pettinville to visit all the animals in town, including a dragon, some cute birds and a lonely cow! Then, she is happily surprised to find a fun slide to play on! She visits with some cute cats, plays on a giant hamster wheel and then helps her new doggy friend get ready to meet his fur-ever family.

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah as she heads to Skyzone to explore the science of bouncing! First, she has a big question... how does someone do a flip? She gets some instruction from an amazing jumper, plays on the trampolines and even learns some numbers. Then, she's off on a solo adventure to answer the question, 'how does bouncing work?' She experiments with different kinds of balls to see which bounces best and even discovers the science behind trampolines!

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Ainnura akhirnya bersedia untuk berkahwin dengan Fariz untuk kali kedua tetapi memberi syarat supaya Rohana sendiri yang meminangnya. Fariz juga tidak dibenarkan mempersoalkan siapa Fawwaz yang sebenarnya kerana Fawwaz bukan anak kandung Fariz sebagaimana yang disangkakan oleh Fariz. Beberapa hari sebelum pernikahan Ainnura dan Fariz, Tok Wan meninggal dunia akibat terjatuh di bilik air.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Selepas kematian Tok Wan, Ilah berhasrat untuk membatalkan perkahwinan Ainnura dengan Fariz. Bagaimanapun Ainnura bertegas untuk meneruskan rancangan mereka kerana itu juga yang dimahukan oleh Tok Wan demi meliah keluarga Ainnura dan keluarga Fariz berdamai. Rohana menyokong keputusan Ainnura dan ini menyebabkan Ilah kecil hati dengan Ainnura. Ilah akhirnya tidak hadir pada hari perkahwinan Ainnura.

programme.title: Dendam Cinta Arissa
programme.desc: Arissa marah pada Zaki bila tahu perkara terakhir yang Zariman buat sebelum dia dilanggar adalah membaca surat luahan dari Zaki pada Arissa. Rafael selamatkan Arissa yang hampir dilanggar kereta.

programme.title: Dendam Cinta Arissa
programme.desc: Rafael mula semakin rapat dengan Arissa. Zarina merasakan yang dia ada peluang untuk memenangi hati Rafael. Zaki mula merasakan yang semua orang semakin berubah dan menjauhkan diri darinya.

programme.title: Dendam Cinta Arissa
programme.desc: Zarina sudah semakin rapat dengan Arissa dan mula dapat menerima Arissa. Zarina semakin mendambakan cinta Rafael, tetapi Rafael lebih memberi perhatian pada Arissa. Rafael masih belum dapat berterus terang tentang kemalangan Zariman.

programme.title: Dendam Cinta Arissa
programme.desc: Zaki yang musykil dengan kehadiran Rafael dalam hidup Arissa dan Zarina mula menyelidik tentang Rafael. Salehan semakin senang melihat Arissa yang semakin pulih. Rafael merasa lebih sukar untuk dia berterus terang bila dia mula menaruh perasaan pada Arissa.

programme.title: Dendam Cinta Arissa
programme.desc: Dalam berdepan dengan tekanan, Rafael juga semakin kerap menerima panggilan dari bekas isterinya, Diana. Zaki cuba untuk memujuk Arissa, namun Arissa masih belum dapat menerima Zaki. Zaki mula berdepan dengan Rafael.

programme.title: Tolong Sempurnakan Cerita Mami
programme.desc: Harez kecil hati bila Deena asyik melebihkan dengan Adwa. Adwa takut Deena terlalu rapat dengannya lalu Adwa membuat perancangan untuk Deena membencinya.

programme.title: Tolong Sempurnakan Cerita Mami
programme.desc: Razean bergegas ke hospital meninggalkan Harez apabila mendapat berita yang Adwa tidak sedarkan diri. Harez merasakan Razean menyembunyikan sesuatu darinya.

programme.title: Tolong Sempurnakan Cerita Mami
programme.desc: Razean cemburu apabila kemunculan Dilla yang sangat rapat dengan Harez. Dilla tidak puas hati dengan Razean kerana dia merasakan Razean tak layak untuk Harez.

programme.desc: Adwa disahkan sihat dan mahu memenangi hati Razean dan Deena semula. Harez dapat tahu yang Razean menerimanya kerana Adwa sakit semata mata.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Tok Wan kurang senang apabila mengetahui Ainnura menjalin semula hubungan dengan Fariz. Dia mahu Ainnura putuskan hubungan dengan Fariz. Justeru, Tok Wan menyokong usaha Ilah untuk menjodohkan Ainnura dengan pemuda pilihan Ilah. Demi cintanya pada Ainnura, Fariz saggup berdepan dengan Tok Wan dalam usaha merayu Tok Wan agar merestui hubungan mereka berdua sebagaimana yang pernah Tok Wan lakukan enam tahun lalu.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Rania cuba menarik perhatian Fariz tetapi usahanya sia-sia. Akhirnya Rania menyerah kalah dan yakin cinta Fariz bukan miliknya. Bagaimanapun Datuk Rashid mendesak Rania supaya usaha lagi dan jangan mudah mengaku kalah. Dia mahu Fariz menjadi menantunya demi legasi syarikat mereka. Sementara itu, kesungguhan Fariz untuk mendapatkan semula Ainnura telah melembutkan hati Tok Wan. Dalam usaha membantu Fariz, Tok Wan sengaja merancangkan sesuatu untuk merapatkan hubungan Fariz dengan Ainnura dan Fawwaz.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Tindakan Tok Wan merapatkan hubungan Ainnura dengan Fariz menimbulkan kemarahan Ilah. Ilah tetap berkeras untuk jodohkan Ainnura dengan lelaki pilihannya. Apabila Ainnura tidak setuju dengan pilihan Ilah, Tok Wan sengaja membuat dalih untuk kahwinkan Ainnura dengan Aidel iaitu kawan rapat Ainnura, bukannya dengan Fariz. Sementara itu, Rohana sudah membayangkan akan bermenantukan anak Datuk apabila Datuk Rashid menjemputnya mereka makan tengah hari sambil berbincang dengan perkahwinan Rania dengan Fariz.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Ainnura akhirnya bersedia untuk berkahwin dengan Fariz untuk kali kedua tetapi memberi syarat supaya Rohana sendiri yang meminangnya. Fariz juga tidak dibenarkan mempersoalkan siapa Fawwaz yang sebenarnya kerana Fawwaz bukan anak kandung Fariz sebagaimana yang disangkakan oleh Fariz. Beberapa hari sebelum pernikahan Ainnura dan Fariz, Tok Wan meninggal dunia akibat terjatuh di bilik air.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Selepas kematian Tok Wan, Ilah berhasrat untuk membatalkan perkahwinan Ainnura dengan Fariz. Bagaimanapun Ainnura bertegas untuk meneruskan rancangan mereka kerana itu juga yang dimahukan oleh Tok Wan demi meliah keluarga Ainnura dan keluarga Fariz berdamai. Rohana menyokong keputusan Ainnura dan ini menyebabkan Ilah kecil hati dengan Ainnura. Ilah akhirnya tidak hadir pada hari perkahwinan Ainnura.

programme.title: Dendam Cinta Arissa
programme.desc: Arissa marah pada Zaki bila tahu perkara terakhir yang Zariman buat sebelum dia dilanggar adalah membaca surat luahan dari Zaki pada Arissa. Rafael selamatkan Arissa yang hampir dilanggar kereta.

programme.title: Dendam Cinta Arissa
programme.desc: Rafael mula semakin rapat dengan Arissa. Zarina merasakan yang dia ada peluang untuk memenangi hati Rafael. Zaki mula merasakan yang semua orang semakin berubah dan menjauhkan diri darinya.

programme.title: Dendam Cinta Arissa
programme.desc: Zarina sudah semakin rapat dengan Arissa dan mula dapat menerima Arissa. Zarina semakin mendambakan cinta Rafael, tetapi Rafael lebih memberi perhatian pada Arissa. Rafael masih belum dapat berterus terang tentang kemalangan Zariman.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Sikap prihatin dan baik Rohana terhadap Ainnura akhirnya terbongkar apabila tujuan Rohana merestui hasrat Fariz untuk megahwini Ainnura hanyalah semata-mata untuk membalas dendam pada Ainnura. Rohana paksa Ainnura tinggal bersamanya dan jika Ainnura menujuk Fariz supaya keluar dari rumah tersebut, dia tidak halal susu yang diminum oleh Fariz serta menganggap Fariz anak derhaka. Sementara itu, dalam diam Ilah sebenarnya merindui Ainnura.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Rohana sengaja menyeksa fizikal dan mental Ainnura. Fazira melihat apa yang dilakukan oleh Rohana terhadap Ainnura lalu mendesak Ainnura dan Fariz keluar dari rumah tersebut. Bagaimanapun Ainnura enggan kerana tidak mahu Fariz dianggap sebagai anak derhaka. Gara-hara terlalu marah dengan Ainnura, Rohana telah menghentak kepala Ainnura ke dinding. Fariz perasan dengan bengkak di kepala Ainnura.

programme.title: Dendam Cinta Arissa
programme.desc: Rafael cuba untuk berterus terang dengan Arissa, tapi tanpa sengaja dia mengakui yang dia cintakan Arissa. Keadaan semakin rumit bagi Rafael apabila Diana pulang ke rumahnya dengan Mimi, cuba untuk pulihkan perkahwinan mereka. Diana mual mencemburui Arissa.

programme.title: Dendam Cinta Arissa
programme.desc: Arissa kesal bila dia telah merosakkan rancangan untuk menyambut harijadi neneknya. Diana mula mencurigai Rafael. Zarina terdengar pengakuan cinta Rafael pada Arissa membuatkan dia rasa seperti ditipu oleh mereka berdua.

programme.desc: Kehadiran Harez sebagai cikgu ganti di kelas Deena mengejutkan Deena bila Harez tahu nama penuhnya. Berita itu juga mengejutkan Razean. Adhwa pula selamba terus terang pada Deena siapa Harez dan hubungan mereka di London buatkan Razean bertambah tertekan.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Fateha dan Rohana terkejut apabila mengetahui Fawwaz adalah anak Fazira hasil hubungan terlarang dengan Raja Azali iaitu kekasih Fateha. Pada mulanya mereka tidak percaya tetapi ketika mereka hendak mendapatkan penjelasan daripada Raja Azali, Raja Azali telah ditangkap polis atas beberapa tuduhan merogol. Fariz meminta maaf di atas sikap Rohana selama ini. Ainnura telah lama memaafkan Rohana tetapi mahu Fariz menceraikannya kerana dia tidak mahu Fariz menjadi anak derhaka gara-garanya. Rohana terharu dengan sikap baik Ainnura dan merayu kemaafan daripada Ainnura.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Ainnura berduka hati kerana tidak dapat bertemu Fariz. Kerana itu, Ainurra nekad melarikan diri menyelamatkan diri tanpa mengetahui ujian terbesar yang harus dihadapi adalah keluarga Fariz. Keluarga Encik Adnan dan Encik Fadzlan menyerang Tokwan. Bagaimana dengan Ainurra dan Fariz?

programme.title: Dendam Cinta Arissa
programme.desc: Arissa sedar bahawa hubungannya dengan Rafael mendapat banyak tentangan. Yaya menjadi ragu-ragu dengan kesihatan mental Arissa setelah menjumpai satu kertas di dalam bilik Arissa.

programme.title: Dendam Cinta Arissa
programme.desc: Diana cuba menghalang rancangan Arissa daripada membuat pendedahan berhubung kematian kes langgar lari Zariman. Setelah berlaku pergelutan sesama mereka, perjumpaan bersama peguam terpaksa ditangguhkan. Mimi diculik semasa keluar bersama Diana, dalam masa yang sama, Zaki berjaya mengesan Arissa dan cuba memujuk Arissa supaya menyerahkan kembali Mimi kepada keluarganya. Arissa memberi amaran kepada Zaki supaya tidak mendedahkan lokasi persembunyian mereka. Berjayakah Zaki memujuk Arissa atau adakah keselamatan Mimi terjamin dengan adanya Zaki?

programme.desc: Gosip tentang hubungan Razean dengan Harez buatkan Deena tertekan sehinggakan keputusan peperiksaan merosot. Razean menyalahkan Harez atas apa yang terjadi. Harez melamar Razean namun lamarannya ditolak dan dia dihalau keluar dari rumah Adwa.

programme.title: Pelindung Seorang Puteri
programme.desc: Rose and Saiful are childhood friends. They meet again when they have become adults. After getting married, Rose realised something is not right about Saiful and his mother.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Keluarga Encik Fadzlan dan Encik Adnan bertemu dengan bomoh untuk memisahkan Ainurra dan Fariz. Pada masa yang sama, Fariz kini sudah mula bekerja. Encik Fadzlan mengupah pengintip memerhatikan gerak geri anaknya.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Encik Fadzlan mengugut Fariz untuk menceraikan Ain. Hingga akhirnya Fariz terpaksa juga menceraikan Ain. Fariz kecewa dengan sikap ayah dan ibunya. Setelah bercerai,Ain mula berubah sikap dan kemurungan. Apakah Fariz akan kembali rujuk pada Ain?

programme.title: Dendam Cinta Arissa
programme.desc: Setelah mendapat bukti Arissa menculik Mimi, Diana dan Rafael ke rumah Arissa dalam usaha untuk mencari beliau tetapi gagal. Yaya, Zarina dan Ajak cuba untuk mengesan dimana lokasi Arissa dan Zaki sebelum polis berjaya menjumpai mereka. Akhirnya Zaki berjaya.

programme.title: Dendam Cinta Arissa
programme.desc: Polis berjaya menahan Arissa sebelum sempat beliau menyerahkan Mimi kepada ibu bapanya. Zaki cuba mendapatkan kata sepakat dengan Rafael supaya menarik balik kes penculikan tersebut. Rafael sedia menarik balik kes tersebut dengan syarat, Arissa dan Zarina turut sama membatalkan pendedahan kes kematian langgar lari Zariman.

programme.title: We’ll be back at 6.00am

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Sikap prihatin dan baik Rohana terhadap Ainnura akhirnya terbongkar apabila tujuan Rohana merestui hasrat Fariz untuk megahwini Ainnura hanyalah semata-mata untuk membalas dendam pada Ainnura. Rohana paksa Ainnura tinggal bersamanya dan jika Ainnura menujuk Fariz supaya keluar dari rumah tersebut, dia tidak halal susu yang diminum oleh Fariz serta menganggap Fariz anak derhaka. Sementara itu, dalam diam Ilah sebenarnya merindui Ainnura.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Rohana sengaja menyeksa fizikal dan mental Ainnura. Fazira melihat apa yang dilakukan oleh Rohana terhadap Ainnura lalu mendesak Ainnura dan Fariz keluar dari rumah tersebut. Bagaimanapun Ainnura enggan kerana tidak mahu Fariz dianggap sebagai anak derhaka. Gara-hara terlalu marah dengan Ainnura, Rohana telah menghentak kepala Ainnura ke dinding. Fariz perasan dengan bengkak di kepala Ainnura.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Ainnura berbohong dengan Fariz yang bengkak di kepalanya akiat terhantuk pada sinki. Dalam waktu yang sama, Rohana mendakwa Ainnura sengaja menolaknya sehinggakan dia hampir terjatuh. Fateha menyokong kata-kata Rohana, menyebabkan Fariz keliru siapakah yang benar di antara isteri dan ibunya. Ainnura bangkit mempertahankan haknya. Selain daripada Ainnura, Fawwaz turut menjadi mangsa Rohana dan Fateha dengan pelbagai penghinaan sehingga akhirnya kerana tidak sanggup melihat Fawwaz dihina, Fazira mengakui yang Fawwaz adalah anaknya.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Fateha dan Rohana terkejut apabila mengetahui Fawwaz adalah anak Fazira hasil hubungan terlarang dengan Raja Azali iaitu kekasih Fateha. Pada mulanya mereka tidak percaya tetapi ketika mereka hendak mendapatkan penjelasan daripada Raja Azali, Raja Azali telah ditangkap polis atas beberapa tuduhan merogol. Fariz meminta maaf di atas sikap Rohana selama ini. Ainnura telah lama memaafkan Rohana tetapi mahu Fariz menceraikannya kerana dia tidak mahu Fariz menjadi anak derhaka gara-garanya. Rohana terharu dengan sikap baik Ainnura dan merayu kemaafan daripada Ainnura.

programme.title: Rindu Yang Terlarang
programme.desc: Ainnur dan Faiq lari ke selatan Thailand untuk bernikah dengan Atuk Ainnur.

programme.title: Dendam Cinta Arissa
programme.desc: Rafael cuba untuk berterus terang dengan Arissa, tapi tanpa sengaja dia mengakui yang dia cintakan Arissa. Keadaan semakin rumit bagi Rafael apabila Diana pulang ke rumahnya dengan Mimi, cuba untuk pulihkan perkahwinan mereka. Diana mual mencemburui Arissa.

programme.title: Dendam Cinta Arissa
programme.desc: Arissa kesal bila dia telah merosakkan rancangan untuk menyambut harijadi neneknya. Diana mula mencurigai Rafael. Zarina terdengar pengakuan cinta Rafael pada Arissa membuatkan dia rasa seperti ditipu oleh mereka berdua.

programme.title: Dendam Cinta Arissa
programme.desc: Arissa semakin tertekan selepas neneknya meninggal. Rafael datang dan cuba untuk berjumpa dengan Arissa, tetapi Arissa berkeras tidak mahu. Zarina dan Zaki dapat tahu siapa sebenarnya yang langar Zariman.

programme.title: Dendam Cinta Arissa
programme.desc: Arissa terkejut bila Zaki beritahu Rafael sebenarnya yang melanggar Zariman. Zarina nekad mahu failkan kes saman dan mahu supaya Rafael ditangkap, tetapi Arissa tidak mahu bekerjasama.

programme.title: Dendam Cinta Arissa
programme.desc: Kehilangan Arissa telah mengakibatkan semua pihak risau terutama sekali Yaya. Adakah gangguan mental Arissa kembali setelah mengetahui siapa sebenarnye yang mengakibatkan kematian Zariman?

programme.title: Tolong Sempurnakan Cerita Mami
programme.desc: Deena mula merasakan hidupnya seperti orang nomad, terpaksa berpindah randah dan cuba untuk satukan semula papa dan maminya yang pada pandangannya mereka berdua masih baik dan tak bergaduh setelah penceraian.

programme.title: Tolong Sempurnakan Cerita Mami
programme.desc: Kehadiran Harez sebagai cikgu ganti di kelas Deena mengejutkan Deena bila Harez tahu nama penuhnya. Berita itu juga mengejutkan Razean. Adhwa pula selamba terus terang pada Deena siapa Harez dan hubungan mereka di London buatkan Razean bertambah tertekan.

programme.title: Tolong Sempurnakan Cerita Mami
programme.desc: Adhwa berterus terang pada tok mama tentang penyakitnya. Razean tertekan apabila Adhwa memaksa dia mencari pengganti. Harez belum putus asa untuk mendekati Razean.

programme.title: Tolong Sempurnakan Cerita Mami
programme.desc: Adhwa meminta Deena untuk meyakinkan maminya untuk menerima Harez. Adhwa meminta Harez tinggal di rumahnya sementara demi memudahkan Harez mendekati Razean. Deena semakin mesra denga Bella dan menyebabkan Razean cemburu.

programme.title: Tolong Sempurnakan Cerita Mami
programme.desc: Harez berusaha tawan hati Tok Mak dan Tok Ayah dan dia berjaya buatkan mereka sukakannya. Harez minta Razean berikan dia satu peluang.

programme.title: Racun Menantu
programme.desc: After marrying Zain, Sara lived in the same house with Pak Dolah, her father-in-law. Because of the family's grudge, Sara started making trouble by seducing her own father-in-law.

programme.title: Cupid
programme.desc: Kisah mengenai seorang ejen yang bekerja di sebuah syarikat penghancur jodoh yang ditugaskan untuk memikat seorang wanita supaya dapat melupakan suaminya yang telah diisytiharkan meninggal dunia. Namun dia jatuh cinta pada wanita tersebut.

programme.title: Cerai
programme.desc: Pengalaman berkurung dengan pasangan selama musim PKP memaksa dua pasangan suami isteri menilai semula perkahwinan mereka yang telah disalah ertikan selama ini.

programme.title: Hingga Jumpa Lagi
programme.desc: Eva is diagnosed with cancer and prays that she could travel back to the past in order to prevent the love between her and her husband so that her husband can lead a happy life. Her prayer is granted….

programme.title: I Heart You Cik Yah
programme.desc: Zulkefli and Badariah are always arguing, but in order to prevent the factory where they work from being closed by Qarina, they must work together. Out of hatred, they start feeling for each other.

programme.title: Jihan Nak Displin Anak
programme.desc: Jihan dan suami kalut apabila anak mereka tidak mahu pulang beraya di kampung. Mereka cuba untuk mendisiplinkan anak mereka sebelum hari raya.

programme.title: Satu Kampung Dua Orang
programme.desc: Selepas banjir besar melanda, semua penduduk kampung berpindah kerana kampung mereka tidak lagi selamat. Hanya dua beradik yang enggan berpindah atas sebab dan alasan mereka tersendiri.

programme.title: Jamil Balik Kampung
programme.desc: Kisah perjalanan Jamil pulang ke kampung untuk meminang kekasihnya setelah pinangannya pernah ditolak beberapa kali. Berjayakah misi Jamil kali ini?

programme.title: Sampai Nanti
programme.desc: Kyle dan Milly bertemu kembali setelah 10 tahun terpisah dan cinta lama kembali terjalin. Tetapi adakah cinta mereka akan terus kekal hingga ke akhirnya?

programme.title: Asam Pedas Cendol Sejoli
programme.desc: Karim adalah pemilik kedai cendol bersebelahan dengan kedai asam pedas Kalsom. Mereka bermusuhan, tetapi anak mereka – Kinah dan Khalil – mencintai satu sama lain, dan terpaksa menyembunyikan perkara ini bagi mengelakkan perang antara dua kedai mereka.

programme.title: Tolong Saya Encik Dinosaur
programme.desc: Elly berpindah dari bandar ke pekan kecil untuk mencari ketenangan. Tetapi kenangan buruk tetap menghantui dirinya, sehinggalah dia bertemu dengan Karl yang mengajarnya erti sebuah kebahagiaan.

programme.title: Cubit - Cubit Cinta

programme.title: Sicily
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

programme.title: Spaghetti & Meatballs
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes – Spaghetti and Meatballs! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Surf and Turf
programme.desc: What on earth and/or sea is super fun host Kim Lallouz cooking this week for her One Big Recipe? You guessed it - Surf and Turf! First on the beach are her Singapore-inspired Chili Crab Cakes, redolent with southeast Asian aromatics and spices like lemongrass, ginger, and galangal. programme.title: Sicily
programme.desc: Simplicity is key with Sicilian cuisine and Chef Michael Bonacini explores just how the region balances simplicity with intensity through four flavourful dishes. Starting with an antipasto of Folded Flatbread with Ricotta and Fennel Seeds, Michael inspires with its intricate beauty with a simple recipe. Keeping to the theme of simplicity, Michael shows that plenty of flavour can come from little ingredients in his primo of Broccoli and Sausage Rigatoni. The spicy sausage and chili is countered by a creamy broccoli pesto for a dish that highlights Sicilian cuisine. Michael turns to the Italian queen of crops for his secondo: Eggplant Parmesan Roll-Ups. With thin slices of eggplant rolled up to contain a mouth-watering mixture of mozzarella, provolone, and pecorino romano, this dish gets an extra kick of flavour from a coating of breadcrumbs and tomato sauce. To bring it all together, Michael combines spicy with sweet through his tender Spiced Chocolate Cookies.

Turkish Eggplant is braised and served with parsley and feta and the Indonesian take is served with fried garlic and sweet soy. For the CombiNATION Plate? Peanut- chili Sate sauce replaces walnut for Pazili TrancÌ§a, a classically Turkish halibut presentation, also served here with unique, savoury, coconut 'baklava' for a plate no-one has ever seen before!

programme.title: Canada + Greece
programme.desc: From Canada to Greece, CombiNATION Plates always covers lots of ground! Kicking off, host Bianca Osbourne wows with ubERS-Canadian Roasted Venison Loin, yummy Fiddlehead Pancakes and sweet-tart Cranberry sauce. Next, enjoy a scenic Mediterranean vacation on a plate with her completely new approach to Greek Salad, taken up a notch or two with tasty seared Albacore Tuna! This episode's 'common ingredient' is lamb shank; check out two wildly creative re- inventions; first, of Canadian TourtieÌ€re, and then, Greek Dolmades. For a final recipe, a dessert fit for a lumberjack or a Greek god! Oka Saganaki with McIntosh Apple Butter and Maple Loukoumades; made with nutty Canadian Oka cheese, fried crisp, flambeÌed with Ouzo, then dusted with dried raspberry powder and maple sugar flakes. 'Opa!' meets Oka!

programme.title: Mexico + Norway
programme.desc: In this episode of CombiNATION Plates, host Bianca Osbourne starts in Mexico with her version of popular street snack, 'Esquites', re-invented here as sweet corn flan. Next is Norway, don't miss explosively exciting quick-smoked Arctic Char with Forage, you've NEVER seen anything like this before. The common ingredient is tacos! From Norway, 'Lefse' is a potato-flour 'tortilla' served with fresh berries and uniquely Scandinavian 'Brunost' cheese. Representing Mexico, check out spicy pork and pineapple 'Tacos al Pastor'. The Big Dish is Lamb Pinnekjott with Birch Bark Tamale, lamb ribs are seasoned, birch bark is stuffed with masa and veggies, both are steamed over birch branches and boozy Akvavit, then plated with dill and bright red chili oil.

programme.desc: What do they eat for brunch in the Middle East? Friendly host Vanessa is excited to show you with these tasty recipes!

programme.title: South Korea + Spain
programme.desc: CombiNATION Plates host Bianca Osbourne is always looking for the best food in the world to share. The first stop is South Korea with her Sesame Crusted Tuna 'Yukhoe', a delicious blend of favourite Korean flavours. Next stamp on the passport? Spain! Mouth-watering Duck Breast is seared and served rare with a crispy artichoke heart, membrillo, olives, and sweet-savoury sherry reduction. Beef short ribs are the common ingredient with Catalonian Braised and Romesco to one side and sticky Korean Kalbi-style grilled to the east! For the topper, drool over Bulgogi Octopus simmered and served with saffron-scented Sticky Rice Paella cakes, finished with crispy Paprika-Gochujang battered mussel. Yep, it tastes as good as it sounds!

programme.title: Ethiopia + Brazil
programme.desc: Travel the world without ever leaving the kitchen! Intrepid host of CombiNATION Plates, Bianca Osbourne, starts this episode with Ethiopian inspired Berbere Spiced Quail, seared in aromatic Niter Kibbeh, and served with crunchy-sour Gomen Salad. Brazil is next, check out this re- invention of Feijoada... with braised and seared pork belly, oranges, crema, and fresh black bean salsa. Common ingredient 'Coffee and Sweets' is next... with java-spiked Injera Crepe Cake for Ethiopia and Brazil blending up a dark roast of rich, coffee-spiked, chocolatey Brigadeiros truffles. The final plate is Coconut Crusted Black Cod with cheesy Brazilian-style Pao de Queijo bites, and teff flour a brush of spiced ghee inspired by Ethiopia.

programme.title: Morocco + Thailand
programme.desc: Join CombiNATION Plates host Bianca Osbourne for a trip to Morocco and Thailand! First up, whole Red Snapper is rubbed with earthy Ras el Hanout spice, poached in argan oil, and served with char-grilled oranges. Thailand inspires the next plate; Chicken Thigh 'Lollipop', roasted and served with bamboo shoots, chilies, and sauced with peanut-coconut red curry. Next, these countries both love Spring Rolls... Morocco's version, Briouat, is stuffed with saffron couscous and fresh cheese and fried... from Thailand comes a salad roll with shrimp and mango, dipped in a fiery green Nam Jim. Stick around for the big dish - Saffron buttERS-basted beef Striploin, served with complex Apricot-Green Curry Chutney and sent spinning with never before seen Chermoula Grass Jelly!

programme.title: Paella
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, steal away to Spain for a summer vacation as host Tiera Singh takes a swing at Paella, complete with sunny saffron, saucy sofrito, and super crunchy soccarat. Next, Missy Hui takes a break for brunch with Chorizo Eggs Benedict - the Saffron Hollandaise is good as gold and twice as bright! Poppy Sandler follows with her Fritto Misto and Sofrito, a delicate and fresh veggie fry-up that soaks up a tomato-spiked sofrito dipping sauce. Micah Trainor finishes up with restaurant-ready Razor Clams steamed in sparkling Spanish wine, served alongside nutty Iberico Ham and sweet Manchego cheese.

programme.title: Shrimp and Sausage
programme.desc: It's all about the letter "S" as Chef Robert Jewell cooks up tasty meals using shrimp and sausage. For his first recipe, Robert fries up turmeric-spiced sweet potato fritters with a shrimp centre. He takes this tantalizing appetizer to another level with a savoury lime soy dipping sauce. Next up, Robert makes an English breakfast strata. This sausage casserole is easily the BEST way to start your day. He layers the bottom of the dish with buttered sourdough slices, before adding crispy fried sausages, leeks and tomatoes. He then covers it in a creamy egg mixture, crumbles stilton on top and bakes it to golden brown. Finally, Robert combines shrimp and sausage into one flavourful dish.

programme.title: Versatile Miso
programme.desc: Miso is an extremely common ingredient in Japanese cuisine. Host Hana Etsuko Dethlefsen shows us how miso can add flavour and richness to any dish.

programme.title: Meatballs and Shakshuka
programme.desc: A Moroccan meal in 30 minutes? That's right! Spencer Watts inspires with Moroccan dishes that are quick to make and bold in flavour.

programme.title: Italy + China
programme.desc: Join engaging host, Bianca Osbourne, for a taste of two countries. First stop? Italy! Check out her recipe for succulent wild boar ribs, braised until tender, rolled in gremolata, and served over silky polenta. Next up? A culinary tribute to China, pairing lobster claw with chili oil, pomelo foam, and oyster sauce glazed bok choy. Every episode features a 'common ingredient', this time? It's noodles! Drool over two recipes: Italian classic Olio e Aglio next to chewy Chinese long Noodles tossed with Sichuan Chili Oil. For the big finale, Bianca blends Italian style with Chinese flavour for a one-of-a-kind CombiNation Plate: Kung Pao Pork Osso Bucco over Forbidden Black Rice Risotto... made with shiitake mushrooms and bright green edamame peas.

programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, steal away to Spain for a summer vacation as host Tiera Singh takes a swing at Paella, complete with sunny saffron, saucy sofrito, and super crunchy soccarat. Next, Missy Hui takes a break for brunch with Chorizo Eggs Benedict - the Saffron Hollandaise is good as gold and twice as bright! Poppy Sandler follows with her Fritto Misto and Sofrito, a delicate and fresh veggie fry-up that soaks up a tomato-spiked sofrito dipping sauce. Micah Trainor finishes up with restaurant-ready Razor Clams steamed in sparkling Spanish wine, served alongside nutty Iberico Ham and sweet Manchego cheese.

programme.title: Shrimp and Sausage
programme.desc: It's all about the letter "S" as Chef Robert Jewell cooks up tasty meals using shrimp and sausage. For his first recipe, Robert fries up turmeric-spiced sweet potato fritters with a shrimp centre. He takes this tantalizing appetizer to another level with a savoury lime soy dipping sauce. Next up, Robert makes an English breakfast strata. This sausage casserole is easily the BEST way to start your day. He layers the bottom of the dish with buttered sourdough slices, before adding crispy fried sausages, leeks and tomatoes. He then covers it in a creamy egg mixture, crumbles stilton on top and bakes it to golden brown. Finally, Robert combines shrimp and sausage into one flavourful dish.

programme.desc: What do they eat for brunch in the Middle East? Friendly host Vanessa is excited to show you with these tasty recipes!

programme.title: Georgia + Hong Kong
programme.desc: Join Bianca Osbourne to taste and combine! Fun CombiNATION Plates host Bianca Osbourne starts this episode with an inspired tribute to Georgian cuisine; Beef Tartare with Tkemali (sour plum sauce), marigold powder, and tart, crunchy pickles. Next; feast your eyes on her unique Hong Kong dumpling: plump scallops, pork, and veggies are blended, rolled, steamed, sliced, and then served with Crispy Yu Choy and XO. The common ingredient is rabbit! Georgia offers up Rabbit 'Mtsvadi', grilled and glazed with pomegranate reduction. Hong Kong represents with Sweet and Sour Rabbit, Grilled Pineapple and Red Pepper Coulis. Finally, Georgian Milk Braised meets Chinese/Hong Kong-style Roast Duck with quail egg and cheese stuffed 'Khachapuri Dumpling' and crunchy 'Peking Duck Crumble', and it's a plate no-one has ever seen before!

programme.title: South Korea + Spain
programme.desc: CombiNATION Plates host Bianca Osbourne is always looking for the best food in the world to share. The first stop is South Korea with her Sesame Crusted Tuna 'Yukhoe', a delicious blend of favourite Korean flavours. Next stamp on the passport? Spain! Mouth-watering Duck Breast is seared and served rare with a crispy artichoke heart, membrillo, olives, and sweet-savoury sherry reduction. Beef short ribs are the common ingredient with Catalonian Braised and Romesco to one side and sticky Korean Kalbi-style grilled to the east! For the topper, drool over Bulgogi Octopus simmered and served with saffron-scented Sticky Rice Paella cakes, finished with crispy Paprika-Gochujang battered mussel. Yep, it tastes as good as it sounds!

programme.title: Ethiopia + Brazil
programme.desc: Travel the world without ever leaving the kitchen! Intrepid host of CombiNATION Plates, Bianca Osbourne, starts this episode with Ethiopian inspired Berbere Spiced Quail, seared in aromatic Niter Kibbeh, and served with crunchy-sour Gomen Salad. Brazil is next, check out this re- invention of Feijoada... with braised and seared pork belly, oranges, crema, and fresh black bean salsa. Common ingredient 'Coffee and Sweets' is next... with java-spiked Injera Crepe Cake for Ethiopia and Brazil blending up a dark roast of rich, coffee-spiked, chocolatey Brigadeiros truffles. The final plate is Coconut Crusted Black Cod with cheesy Brazilian-style Pao de Queijo bites, and teff flour a brush of spiced ghee inspired by Ethiopia.

programme.title: Morocco + Thailand
programme.desc: Join CombiNATION Plates host Bianca Osbourne for a trip to Morocco and Thailand! First up, whole Red Snapper is rubbed with earthy Ras el Hanout spice, poached in argan oil, and served with char-grilled oranges. Thailand inspires the next plate; Chicken Thigh 'Lollipop', roasted and served with bamboo shoots, chilies, and sauced with peanut-coconut red curry. Next, these countries both love Spring Rolls... Morocco's version, Briouat, is stuffed with saffron couscous and fresh cheese and fried... from Thailand comes a salad roll with shrimp and mango, dipped in a fiery green Nam Jim. Stick around for the big dish - Saffron buttERS-basted beef Striploin, served with complex Apricot-Green Curry Chutney and sent spinning with never before seen Chermoula Grass Jelly!

programme.title: Italy + China
programme.desc: Join engaging host, Bianca Osbourne, for a taste of two countries. First stop? Italy! Check out her recipe for succulent wild boar ribs, braised until tender, rolled in gremolata, and served over silky polenta. Next up? A culinary tribute to China, pairing lobster claw with chili oil, pomelo foam, and oyster sauce glazed bok choy. Every episode features a 'common ingredient', this time? It's noodles! Drool over two recipes: Italian classic Olio e Aglio next to chewy Chinese long Noodles tossed with Sichuan Chili Oil. For the big finale, Bianca blends Italian style with Chinese flavour for a one-of-a-kind CombiNation Plate: Kung Pao Pork Osso Bucco over Forbidden Black Rice Risotto... made with shiitake mushrooms and bright green edamame peas.

programme.title: Turkey + Indonesia
programme.desc: Turkey, think Silk Road spices. Indonesia, lots of seafood and tropical fruits! Curious and adventurous host Bianca Osbourne is your CombiNATION Plates culinary guide through both food cultures. First, check out Turkish Spice Crusted Lamb Rack with yogurt and blistered peppers. Next, an Indonesian tribute: Crab Leg with Coconut Curry. For the 'common ingredient'? Two takes on tender, savoury eggplant! Turkish Eggplant is braised and served with parsley and feta and the Indonesian take is served with fried garlic and sweet soy. For the CombiNATION Plate? Peanut- chili Sate sauce replaces walnut for Pazili TrancÌ§a, a classically Turkish halibut presentation, also served here with unique, savoury, coconut 'baklava' for a plate no-one has ever seen before!

programme.title: ANGEL OF DEATH
programme.desc: Efren Saldivar always preferred the graveyard shift at Glendale Adventist Medical Center, where he worked as a respiratory therapist. It was during the late hours of the night, when Saldivar would inject his patients with a drug suppressing their breathing, paralyzing, and eventually killing them. Though doctors would eventually find the therapist in possession of the illicit drugs and fire him, it would be several years before detectives could uncover enough evidence to convict Saldivar.

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: The Minibods are having a day of drawing, painting, music and a quick fix! Newt is drawing a beautiful flower but keeps rushing and crumpling her drawings, so she must learn to slow down. Then, when the Minibods help her finish a huge painting, Newt wants it all for herself! The creative chaos continues as Lulu struggles to make a music video with a marching Oddbird and Bubbles accidentally makes a mess while trying to fix a book dispenser.

programme.title: Minibods
programme.desc: Join the Minibods for an adventure with pedals, rescues and stars! Lulu goes camping but realizes she's left her favorite Binky Bunny behind and has to learn how to cope. Then, Newt goes on an adventure to find a real-life Flutterbug, but she has to be brave when her bike's stabilizers come off! The adventures continue as Jeff overcomes his fear of mud to rescue his feather duster and Bubbles builds a rocket to try and reach a big purple star in the sky!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Join JJ and his friends for a fun school day at Melon Patch Academy! Ms. Appleberry finds exciting ways to learn, like using building blocks and drawings to practice the alphabet. Then, the kids play a fun guessing game to learn all about the five senses and how to sign them in ASL! The learning continues as they sing about the days of the week, play a fun alphabet photo game on a rainy day and enjoy story time with the whole family. It's a day packed with learning and fun!

programme.title: CoComelon
programme.desc: Come on and join JJ's fun learning club! The adventure starts with a field trip to the farm where JJ and his friends learn to count to ten using apples. The learning continues in the classroom as Ms. Appleberry sends the kids on a scavenger hunt to find items in every color of the rainbow. Even lunchtime is fun, as the family finds all the different shapes in JJ's lunch! From taking care of pets to learning yoga, there's always something new to learn!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: It's time for Blippi to get curious and creative! A mysterious book appears in the clubhouse, and when Blippi opens it, the brand-new Curiosity Crew jumps out! After helping the crew figure out what they're looking for (popsicles!), Blippi and Meekah join them on some creative adventures. They learn all about how to mix colors to make a beautiful rainbow painting, shrink down to dance with Bendjamin the Klutz and ride a library cart on a hunt for books about dinosaurs!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is wondering, 'How does it work?!' Join Blippi and his robot buddy FETCH on an adventure to find the answers! Blippi shrinks down to fly inside a beehive and learn how honey is made, and explores a garbage truck to find out why flies love it so much. Then, it's a trip through a factory to see how chocolate is made! The adventure even travels through time as Blippi meets his great-grandpa to see the very first cars. Plus, Blippi and FETCH help a nervous crane learn to build a skyscraper!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is on an adventure from dinosaurs to pet knights! He travels back in time with Tabbs to help a little Microraptor prove that being small has its benefits when they rescue a giant sauropod from the mud. Then, they head to the African savannah to learn how to roar, sneak and pounce like a lion! Back at the clubhouse, Blippi learns how to interpret a puppy's tail wags and even travels back in time again to help a real-life knight in shining armor-who happens to be a corgi!

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: Join Ella for a super fun day at Lellobee City Farm! First, when a nest of baby duck eggs starts to hatch, Ella has to play 'Mummy Duck' to keep all the cute but runaway ducklings together! Then, Rishi organizes all the animals for a friendly game of soccer, where everyone learns each other's animal sounds. The fun day ends with a new arrival, as Ella and Mei find and adopt a stray cat named Bingo, welcoming him to his new home!

programme.title: Lellobee City Farm
programme.desc: It's a day of big surprises at Lellobee City Farm! The adventure begins when Ella and Bee find a mysterious egg and have no idea who it belongs to. They become 'The Egg Detectives' and question all the birds, only to find out it's a tortoise egg! The surprises continue with the arrival of a brand new tractor and a visit from two very special guests: tiger twins who love to play hide-and-seek!

programme.title: Dance Party
programme.desc: Get ready for a barnyard boogie with JJ and his friends! The dance party kicks off on the farm with a fun rendition of the 'Yes, Yes Vegetable Song,' where all the animals come to dance. Then, it's time to wake up the little bunny friends with a merry tune and hop, march and skip around! Join the fun as the kids sing 'Old Macdonald,' ride a little green tractor to find their animal pals and search for five little ducks all over the farm. It's a day full of singing, dancing and farm fun!

programme.title: JJ's Animal Time
programme.desc: Get ready for some messy mayhem in the clubhouse! The chaos begins when a slime volcano erupts, and the friends have to jump on pillows to avoid the gooey mess. Then, Boba finds a magical mirror that creates a colorful clone of him every time he looks! Can he hide all the new Bobas before JJ finds out? The messy fun continues as the friends chase a fly during breakfast and Wally tries to sneak a bite of frosting while baking alphabet cupcakes.

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Get ready for chaos with Orphle and Winston's worst ideas ever! First, Doubler accidentally multiplies monster truck Orphle, and all the new Orphles team up to cause trouble in Pet Port! Then, Winston wants to be turned into a big cat, but a Magic Pet accidentally turns him into a big rat instead, forcing Mila and Morphle to find him. The bad ideas continue as the two villains try to cheat to win a game of Capture the Flag!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Mila and Morphle are on the case, solving the biggest mysteries in town! When Aunt Augustine's new necklace is stolen, Detective Mila and Morphle find clues to track down the culprits. Then, Winston and the Bandits steal a time machine and use it to go to the future! Mila and Morphle must follow them to get it back. The mysteries continue as the Bandits steal Morphle and the friends must find him, and a body swap device causes a confusing mix-up!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Get ready for some sci-fi mayhem with Arpo and Baby Daniel! The chaos begins when Daniel accidentally switches Arpo to zero-gravity mode, causing the robot and everything he touches to float around the city! Then, Arpo accidentally shrinks Baby Daniel with a shrink ray and has to search frantically for the tiny toddler. The out-of-this-world adventure continues when the pesky squirrel takes Daniel on an unexpected trip to outer space in a make-believe rocket!

programme.title: ARPO
programme.desc: Mom's crazy inventions are going haywire! First, Arpo and Daniel have fun with the new voice-controlled smart house, until it starts having a tantrum and they have to figure out how to calm it down. Then, Mom's new time travel machine accidentally turns a pigeon into a giant pterodactyl, forcing Arpo to catch it! The mayhem continues when Daniel takes a flying smartcrib on a joyride and Arpo has to chase a remote-controlled truck that's gone out of control!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Join the crew for some fun competitions and a day of helping friends! First, the friends compete in a fun obstacle course to see who can finish the race the fastest and lift the special trophy! Then, just as the crew is ready to demolish an old building, a cute cat hops inside, and the team must rescue the kitten before finishing the job. The helping continues as they save another kitten from a dangerous situation and Dazey must think fast to save Mrs. Skip from a runaway river barge!

programme.title: Digley & Dazey
programme.desc: Get ready for playground games and construction fun! First, the crew has to build a crazy golf course! After they finish, they decide to try it out, but something goes wrong every time! Then, at the beach, Digley and Dazey challenge each other to a sandcastle competition. They each build castles that get bigger and sillier, and after some bickering, they decide to build one giant castle together! Plus, learn the alphabet and sing 'If You're Happy and You Know It'!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: The ultimate rivalry between Gecko and Mr. Weasel heats up! After a big rainstorm, Weasel challenges Gecko to a head-to-head car wash competition. Then, Weasel decides he wants a Mechanical of his own, so he hatches a scheme to try and steal Gecko's secret plans! The rivalry continues as Weasel tries to show off his new sports car but gets stuck, and his automated car wash mistakes Weasel for his car!

programme.title: Gecko's Garage
programme.desc: Join Gecko for some of his ultimate rescue missions! Blue must face his fear of a storm to save Eric the Excavator, who is stuck in a trench with a dam about to overflow! Then, Weasel fits Vicky the Ice Cream truck with a super-fast rocket, causing her to speed out of control! Gecko and the Mechanicals must stop her before she crashes. From saving a trapped Mummy Truck to rescuing the Mechs, it's always a big adventure!

programme.title: JJ's Animal Time
programme.desc: Join JJ and his animal friends on a big imagination adventure! First, Wally teaches everyone how to sail like real pirates, but they'll need to work together to stay on course! Then, when Mimi gets hungry, she decides the moon must be made of cheese, so the friends build a rocketship to fly there and find out! The adventure continues as they follow a treasure map to find special shape keys and help Little Red Riding JJ avoid Wally Wolf's silly traps in the woods.

programme.title: Dance Party
programme.desc: It's a dance party featuring all your favorite classic rhymes! Join JJ, Bella and Cece as they dance to 'Hey Diddle Diddle' while the cow jumps over the moon. The fun continues as they help their friend Humpty Dumpty get home after a great fall with the help of some sea creature friends! Then, get ready to rock out with a band of monkeys in a brand-new version of 'Rockabye Baby.' From 'Five Little Speckled Frogs' to 'Looby Loo,' it's a dance party full of classic fun!

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: The Sharksons are using their brains for some clever underwater fixes! When all the contents of Tucker's bag fall out from a hole in his backpack, Stanley and Grub help him fix it so he can get to school. Then, when Grub can't get to sleep because she's afraid of the dark, Stanley has a clever idea to make a 'star' night light from a glove that floated down. From turning veggies into a fun game to sorting recycling, there's always a clever fix!

programme.title: The Sharksons
programme.desc: Get ready for a super fun underwater sing-along with The Sharksons! Join the fun as five little reef sharks learn their lesson about jumping on the bed. Then, meet an 'Itsy Bitsy' sea spider who keeps trying to climb an underwater cliff with a little help from her friends! The classic rhymes continue with a curious crab acting out the story of Humpty Dumpty and a cozy pajama party with ten friends in a bed. It's a sing-along full of classic tunes with a fun, fishy twist!

programme.title: Playtime With Twinkle
programme.desc: Go on a magical sky adventure with Twinkle! First, discover the variety of cloud shapes and sizes, from triangles and squares to star-shaped clouds! Then, daydream high in the clouds with Twinkle and Mr. Moon, where her magical stardust makes the moon sneeze and keeps changing colors! The sky-high fun continues as Twinkle soars through the sky on a magical journey to explore all the vibrant colors of the rainbow.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Birkenhead, Inspector Anthony Joynes is accompanied by the police to attend an unlocked and empty property. Inside he finds Teddy, the terrified Terrier cross that has a flea infestation so bad that he's missing half his fur. One-year-old Teddy is incredibly nervous, but will he be able to overcome his fears and allow the RSPCA to offer him help?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr. Matt pays his weekly visit to Flamingoland, near Malton in North Yorkshire, and is called to inspect a new arrival, a male Asian Sarus Crane brought in as company to a resident female. They are an endangered species but the cranes haven't yet warmed to each other and Matt offers advice.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: Lucy the Staffie cross has been kept inside a dark house for so long that it's affected her eyes and she is extremely overweight. She is taken into the RSPCA's care but will Lucy be able to shed some pounds and adapt to life in the great outdoors?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Guppies in the wild aren't as beautiful as we see them in the aquarium. Many think they are mosquitofishes, but in reality, wild guppies and mosquitofishes were originally introduced from abroad for the purpose of preventing and treating malaria. However, unlike mosquitofishes, they are not seen everywhere in the wild. Instead, they were introduced into the aquarium market. Because guppies have genetic variability, especially the changing colors and patterns on their tail fins, their original wild patterns and colors have gradually been forgotten by everyone.

programme.desc: The Call duck is a domestic duck species native to the Netherlands. Males can weigh about 570 to 680 grams. Because its call is different from other ducks, Call Ducks were bred as hunting ducks, now most of them are used as pets. They mainly live in the Netherlands, Japan, and Southeast Asia. They were introduced to the pet market in recent years and were originally used by European hunters to lure wild ducks using their call. Their ducklings are described as having fair skin, big breasts and round butts. They can heal people's moods, and their cute appearance adds joy.

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old. Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers. Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again. When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water. nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan. In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo. Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled. If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants. Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories. programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years. Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners. Their large size is one of their features. Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better. If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors. Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets.

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E01 - Best Moments Part 1
programme.desc: Brothers Chris and Casey Keefer look back on some of the best moments from the first two seasons of Dropped. They discuss their most unforgettable solo hunts and how the show has changed over time.

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E02 - Best Moments Part 2
programme.desc: Brothers Chris and Casey Keefer look back on some of the best moments from the first two seasons of Dropped. They chat about behind-the-scenes stuff no one has seen and give a sneak peek into what's coming up in Season 3.

programme.title: Dropped - S03:E03 - Dropped And Dragging
programme.desc: Chris and Casey Keefer, two brothers, set off on another adventure in the wilds of Alaska. They're exploring a river system that hasn't been hunted in over ten years because of predators. The journey begins slowly, with the brothers spending more time dragging their gear than floating, in a place teeming with grizzlies.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E09 - Mountain Lion Attack
programme.desc: Marine Anne Hjelle was mountain biking when she was ripped off her bike by a mountain lion. Anne fought back even as the big cat shredded her face in its jaws. Surviving the attack was only the beginning of Anne's incredible fight to survive.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S03:E10 - Soul of a Survivor
programme.desc: Craig DeMartino examines the stories of other survivors he's met across the season. Their survival stories are all different, but Craig discovers that these survivors share more in common than you might think.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E01 - Lost!
programme.desc: Nick and Laura subject themselves to intense survival training with the Survival Training School of California deep in the mountains.

programme.title: Survival Science - S01:E02 - Sniper Science
programme.desc: Nick and Laura explore the variety of skills that military snipers use: marksmanship, long range shooting, detection, stalking, camouflage, infiltration, special reconnaissance and target acquisition.

programme.title: Survival Science - - S01:E03 - Surviving a Bear Attack
programme.desc: Nick and Laura test the power and speed of grizzly bears using Hollywood stunt tools to experience an attack. Also: an attempt to recreate an arrow shot that saved a man from a bear attack.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E35 - Prince Charles At 50 Heir To Sadness
programme.desc: After Diana's death, everyone's attention turned to Charles, who was not only a widower and a dad but also next in line for the throne. This show takes a closer look at how he got along with his sons, his longtime love Camilla, and what his future might look like as King. Royal experts David Starkey and Anthony Holden share their insights.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E34 - Prince William And Prince Harry The Next Royal Generation
programme.desc: Prince William and Prince Harry, along with their friends, got as much media attention as today’s pop stars, fashion icons, and movie celebs. This documentary explores how this affected their personal lives and friendships, showcasing how they managed their fame alongside their royal responsibilities.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E09 - The LZ
programme.desc: Chris and Casey Keefer must push to reach the LZ with a failing raft. With only a few hours before extraction, will Mother Nature get the best of them before they can get to safety?

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E10 - After the Drop
programme.desc: Back from their punishing experience in the New Zealand wilderness brothers Chris and Casey Keefer sit down to discuss the ups, downs and pivotal moments from their recent adventure.

programme.title: Wardens - S05:E01 - Never Ending Day
programme.desc: The Wardens' day starts early with an opportunity to capture a convicted game violator who has dodged the law for over 3 years. But just as one case closes another begins - forcing them to work late into the night.

programme.title: Wardens - S05:E02 - Angry Like A Moose
programme.desc: The wardens are called in to round up a 1,000 pound bully.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E11 - Counter Terrorism
programme.desc: Following the September 11 attacks, military presence became commonplace in New York and other American cities, and the counter terrorism forces were effectively given a "blank cheque" when it came to ensuring that another terrorist incident would never take place on American soil. This episode of CQB takes an in–depth look at who was selected to occupy elite anti-terrorist positions, what they were trained for, and how they were equipped: when opposing forces are using commercial airliners and chemical weapons, countermeasures are by necessity complicated and varied. CQB takes an intimate look at what it was like to be an officer on alert for chemical attacks in Washington DC, or an army reservist monitoring suspicious activities on the streets of NYC.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E12 - French Foreign Legion
programme.desc: No country other than France operates an elite military force that invites foreign nationals to serve in its ranks. With a reputation for being a safe haven for individuals with questionable pasts, the French Foreign Legion is a true mercenary army that has garnered significant respect within the global special operations community. This episode of CQB examines a raid by the Foreign Legion on a small airport in Iraq during the 1990 Gulf War, exploring the nature of the Legion, how it differs from other special forces, and how it prepares for a wide variety of close quarter battle scenarios in conflict situations around the world.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes - S01:E07 - Little Big Solutions
programme.desc: Quail and their habitat are studied in Texas.

programme.title: Wildlife Heroes - S01:E08 - Legacy
programme.desc: A family of conservationists capture and study elephants in Zimbabwe.

programme.title: Harry & Meghan: A Very Modern Romance
programme.desc: Meghan Markle and Prince Harry share similar interests and seem like a perfect match. Both have faced tough times growing up but have come out on top. Now they're winning together. This hour-long special, featuring a chat with author Andrew Morton, explores the social backdrop that makes their bold marriage fit right in with today's British Royal Family.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E11 - Counter Terrorism
programme.desc: Following the September 11 attacks, military presence became commonplace in New York and other American cities, and the counter terrorism forces were effectively given a "blank cheque" when it came to ensuring that another terrorist incident would never take place on American soil. This episode of CQB takes an in–depth look at who was selected to occupy elite anti-terrorist positions, what they were trained for, and how they were equipped: when opposing forces are using commercial airliners and chemical weapons, countermeasures are by necessity complicated and varied. CQB takes an intimate look at what it was like to be an officer on alert for chemical attacks in Washington DC, or an army reservist monitoring suspicious activities on the streets of NYC.

programme.title: Close Quarter Battle - S01:E12 - French Foreign Legion
programme.desc: No country other than France operates an elite military force that invites foreign nationals to serve in its ranks. With a reputation for being a safe haven for individuals with questionable pasts, the French Foreign Legion is a true mercenary army that has garnered significant respect within the global special operations community. This episode of CQB examines a raid by the Foreign Legion on a small airport in Iraq during the 1990 Gulf War, exploring the nature of the Legion, how it differs from other special forces, and how it prepares for a wide variety of close quarter battle scenarios in conflict situations around the world.

programme.desc: Ten years ago, thousands of US and Coalition forces personnel, ranging from elite soldiers to reservists, found themselves in the middle of two conflicts that required an entirely different approach to warfare than they had previously experienced. From special forces units securing vital points of strategic interest and capturing key individuals in Afghanistan. This episode of CQB takes a close look at how special operations were integrated into regular units and how they fought through many close quarter combat situations with a combination of intelligence, high-tech weaponry and surveillance technologies to find and capture Saddam Hussein.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E13 - Who is the King?
programme.desc: It is estimated that there are approximately 8.7 million different species of animals on Earth. programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E01 - Naturally Breathtaking
programme.desc: Do you know where in the world the last untouched glacier is? Where is the highest and the smallest waterfall? Which desert is the driest or the largest? Would you like to know where the most inaccessible mountains, the lowest point of the oceans or the great salt deserts are? This series offers all the answers.In the first episode, we discover breathtaking glaciers in Argentina, infinite plane in the middle of Europe, thermal miracles of Hungary, stalactite caves protected by UNESCO and the most active volcano in New Zealand – White island.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E02 - Naturally Dramatic
programme.desc: This episode describes the greatest miracle of nature that could be created by the human brain. The Loch Ness monster. It looks that is does not exist but thousands of visitors still come to see the lovely lake and to hear tales about it. Not only Nessi, but the Scottish high lands are the miracle of nature.Then we quickly visit Andalusia and remove our hat in front of the majestic mountains of Sierra Nevada.The deepest lake in the world is found in Siberia. We will talk about Baikal, the natural miracle of Russia.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E03 - Naturally Diverse
programme.desc: The episode focuses on the Arabian peninsula. The endless red desert in Oman contrasts with Yemen ́s island of Socotra.
